# SignalK CLI

> Command line access to SignalK APIs and streaming data

Python CLI to query the SignalK v2 History API and v1 Streaming API, exporting to CSV, JSON, JSON Lines or Apache Arrow Feather. Installed as `signalk-cli`, run as `signalk_cli.history` and `signalk_cli.stream`.

## Usage

- [Home](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/index.md): Installation, host discovery, commands, options and examples

## Python library

- [Python library](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/library/index.md): Using signalk-cli from Python — history and streaming clients, tables, errors
- [History API](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/api/history/index.md): HistoryClient, HistoryResult, TimeRange reference
- [Streaming API](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/api/stream/index.md): StreamClient, DeltaStream, DeltaMessage, DeltaRow reference
- [Tables, errors and discovery](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/api/common/index.md): ArrowTable, SignalKError, discover_host reference

- [What's New](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/changelog/index.md): Changes in each release
